items.title: Angry Syrians protest over sharp rise in fuel prices
items.excerpt: Syrians took to the streets for a second day on Monday to demonstrate against a shock government decision to raise fuel prices by up to 40 per cent, extending the largest protests since the fall of Bashar Al Assad's regime in December 2024.
